  PROBLEM: The tests run the step body directly and none asserts that the workflow step has no `continue-on-error: true` and no narrowing `if:`.
  WHY: A later `continue-on-error: true` on `Preflight workflow script references` (test-and-mark-stable.yml:347-370) would make the check advisory and all seven live E2E jobs would run, with every test still passing.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add `changelog.d/release-static-preflight.md` per CLAUDE.md §20, mentioning the `RELEASE_STATIC_PREFLIGHT_ENABLED` switch (default on)."
  Expected change site: changelog.d/release-static-preflight.md, after the table
  Evidence of absence: The fragment mentions the switch and its default, so the requirement is met. `Added time | seconds` is not a measured number, and there is no closing "What this means for ..." paragraph. Only `Extra GitHub API calls | 0` is concrete.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Wire the new test file into `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: add it to an existing pytest/python test step whose topic covers release workflows. Do not create a new job."
  Expected change site: an existing step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, e.g. "Release notification superseded-run tests" (line 1760)
  Evidence of absence: The diff adds a separate step "Release static preflight contract tests" (ci.yml lines 1765-1768) and drops the blank line before `- name: Release CI gate tests` (line 1769). No new job was created and the CI wiring guard is satisfied.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml line 370 (`python3 "${checker}"`) | The FAIL lines produce no `::error::` annotation. Suggested fix: `python3 "${checker}" || { echo "::error::Workflow script reference preflight failed; see FAIL lines above"; exit 1; }` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
